heading: Acceptance of contributions from public and private sources; cooperation with other agencies in prosecution of projects
lead: In fiscal year 1987 and thereafter the United States Geological Survey is authorized to accept lands, buildings, equipment, and other contributions from public and private sources and to prosecute projects in cooperation with other agencies, Federal, State, or private.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Pub. L. 99–591 is a corrected version of Pub. L. 99–500.

notes.heading: Change of Name
notes.text: “United States Geological Survey” substituted in text for “Geological Survey” pursuant to provision of title I of Pub. L. 102–154, set out as a note under section 31 of this title.
